info.name: What To Eat API
info.description: Complete API collection for What To Eat application

request.description: Refresh access token using refresh token
Create a new user (requires CREATE_USER permission)
Get all users with pagination (requires FIND_ALL_USER permission)
Get a specific user by ID (requires FIND_ONE_USER permission)
Get all dishes with filtering and pagination (public)
Create a new dish (requires CREATE_DISH permission)

item.name: Get Ingredient By Title and Language

request.description: Get ingredient by title and language (public)
Create a new ingredient (requires CREATE_INGREDIENT permission)
Get all dish votes (requires FIND_ALL_DISH_VOTE permission)
Get dish vote by ID (requires FIND_ONE_DISH_VOTE permission)
Create a dish vote (requires CREATE_DISH_VOTE permission)
Create a new role (requires CREATE_ROLE permission)
Get role by ID (requires FIND_ONE_ROLE permission)
Get role by name (requires FIND_ONE_ROLE permission)
Get contact by ID (requires FIND_ONE_CONTACT permission)
Create a contact form submission (public, rate limited: 5 requests per minute)
Get message history for a chat room
Send a message (REST API alternative to Socket.IO)
Add or remove reaction to a message
Get all user login tracks (requires FIND_ALL_USER_LOGIN_TRACK permission)

item.name: Get User Logins By User ID

request.description: Get login history for a specific user (requires FIND_USER_LOGIN_TRACK permission)
Get all website visits (requires FIND_ALL_WEBSITE_VISIT permission)
Create feedback (public, rate limited: 3 requests per minute)
Add dish to favorites (requires MANAGE_USER_FAVORITES permission)
Get user's favorite dishes (requires MANAGE_USER_FAVORITES permission)
Remove dish from favorites (requires MANAGE_USER_FAVORITES permission)
Check if dish is in favorites (requires MANAGE_USER_FAVORITES permission)
Save dish with notes (requires MANAGE_USER_SAVED_DISHES permission)
Get user's saved dishes (requires MANAGE_USER_SAVED_DISHES permission)
Update saved dish notes and tags (requires MANAGE_USER_SAVED_DISHES permission)
Check if dish is saved (requires MANAGE_USER_SAVED_DISHES permission)
Create or update dietary preferences (requires MANAGE_USER_DIETARY_PREFERENCES permission)
Get user's dietary preferences (requires MANAGE_USER_DIETARY_PREFERENCES permission)
Mark dish as cooked (requires MANAGE_USER_DISH_INTERACTIONS permission)
Get user's dish interactions (requires MANAGE_USER_DISH_INTERACTIONS permission)
Get top interacted dishes (requires MANAGE_USER_DISH_INTERACTIONS permission)
Get popularity metrics for a dish (public)

request.description: Create a dish collection (requires MANAGE_USER_DISH_COLLECTIONS permission)
Get collection by ID (requires MANAGE_USER_DISH_COLLECTIONS permission)
Add dish to collection (requires MANAGE_USER_DISH_COLLECTIONS permission)
Remove dish from collection (requires MANAGE_USER_DISH_COLLECTIONS permission)
Reorder dishes in collection (requires MANAGE_USER_DISH_COLLECTIONS permission)
Get personalized random dish recommendations (requires ACCESS_PERSONALIZED_RANDOM permission)
Get user's preference summary (requires VIEW_USER_PREFERENCE_SUMMARY permission)
